checkoutservice->shippingservice and frontend->shippingservice both show 100% errors, indicating shippingservice is the root cause.
frontend->checkoutservice also shows 100% errors, but checkoutservice's own errors are due to shippingservice failure downstream, so checkoutservice is a victim, not a culprit.
shippingservice's own p95 latency is low (0.47ms) but it has 100% errors, consistent with being down.
